# Contributing to Hackathon App

Thank you for your interest in contributing! Please follow these guidelines to ensure smooth collaboration.

## Code of Conduct

Be respectful, inclusive, and professional in all interactions.

## Getting Started

1. Fork the repository
2. Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/hackathon-app.git`
3. Add upstream: `git remote add upstream https://github.com/lyesg46/hackathon-app.git`
4. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name`

## Development Setup

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start development environment
docker compose up

# Run tests
npm test

# Build
npm run build
```

## Submitting Changes

1. Keep commits atomic and well-described
2. Push to your fork
3. Create a Pull Request with a clear description
4. Link related issues using `Closes #issue-number`
5. Ensure all checks pass before requesting review

## Commit Guidelines

- Use clear, descriptive commit messages
- Use imperative mood ("Add feature" not "Added feature")
- Reference issues when relevant: `Fix #123`

## Pull Request Guidelines

- Keep PRs focused on a single feature or fix
- Write a clear description of changes
- Include tests for new functionality
- Update documentation as needed
- Request reviews from maintainers

## Code Style

Follow the existing code style in the repository. Run linters and formatters before committing.

## Questions?

Open an issue or reach out to the maintainers.
